mapper.select: SELECT * FROM h_message WHERE (message_sender_id = #{userId} AND message_sender_type = #{userType}) OR (message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND message_receiver_type = #{userType}) ORDER BY message_create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_message WHERE (message_sender_id = #{userId} AND message_sender_type = #{userType}) OR (message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND message_receiver_type = #{userType})

SELECT partner.partner_id AS id, partner.partner_type AS type, partner.last_time, partner.unread_count, last_msg.message_content AS last_content, last_msg.message_content_type AS last_content_type, last_msg.message_title AS last_title, last_msg.message_type AS last_message_type, last_msg.message_id AS last_msg_id, last_msg.message_sender_id AS last_sender_id, last_msg.message_sender_type AS last_sender_type, last_msg.message_receiver_id AS last_receiver_id, last_msg.message_receiver_type AS last_receiver_type FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN m.message_sender_type = 1 AND m.message_sender_id = 0 THEN 0 WHEN m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType} THEN m.message_sender_id ELSE m.message_receiver_id END AS partner_id, CASE WHEN m.message_sender_type = 1 AND m.message_sender_id = 0 THEN 1 WHEN m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType} THEN m.message_sender_type ELSE m.message_receiver_type END AS partner_type, MAX(m.message_create_time) AS last_time, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.message_is_read = 0 AND m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType} THEN 1 END) AS unread_count FROM h_message m WHERE ( (m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType}) OR (m.message_sender_id = #{userId} AND m.message_sender_type = #{userType} AND NOT (m.message_sender_type = 1 AND m.message_sender_id = 0)) ) AND NOT (m.message_sender_id = #{userId} AND m.message_sender_type = #{userType} AND m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN m.message_sender_type = 1 AND m.message_sender_id = 0 THEN 0 WHEN m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType} THEN m.message_sender_id ELSE m.message_receiver_id END, CASE WHEN m.message_sender_type = 1 AND m.message_sender_id = 0 THEN 1 WHEN m.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_receiver_type = #{userType} THEN m.message_sender_type ELSE m.message_receiver_type END ) partner LEFT JOIN h_message last_msg ON last_msg.message_id = ( SELECT m3.message_id FROM h_message m3 WHERE ( (partner.partner_id = 0 AND partner.partner_type = 1 AND m3.message_sender_type = 1 AND m3.message_sender_id = 0 AND m3.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m3.message_receiver_type = #{userType}) OR ((m3.message_sender_id = partner.partner_id AND m3.message_sender_type = partner.partner_type AND m3.message_receiver_id = #{userId} AND m3.message_receiver_type = #{userType}) OR (m3.message_sender_id = #{userId} AND m3.message_sender_type = #{userType} AND m3.message_receiver_id = partner.partner_id AND m3.message_receiver_type = partner.partner_type)) ) ORDER BY m3.message_create_time DESC, m3.message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY partner.last_time DESC
